professionalSummary.text: Platform Engineer with three years of ownership over a credit workflow system’s Kubernetes runtime, responsible for all production configuration changes and platform stability.
professionalSummary.witness: Owned the runtime platform for the credit workflow system for three years, deciding and executing production configuration changes to the Kubernetes clusters myself as the platform's named owner, with the change record carrying my approval and my execution.

professionalSummary.text: Expertise in building and maintaining infrastructure code using Terraform and Helm, and in designing deployment pipelines that promote applications through test, staging, and production environments.
professionalSummary.witness: Built and maintained the platform's infrastructure code (Terraform, Helm charts) and the deployment pipelines that promote the workflow application through test, staging and production.

professionalSummary.text: Led weekly platform change reviews, making scheduling decisions and documenting outcomes in a change-review log.
professionalSummary.witness: Led the weekly platform change review, deciding which application and platform changes were scheduled into the production window and recording the decisions in the change-review log.

professionalSummary.text: Coordinated change activities with application and security teams, clearly delineating ownership of cluster configuration, application configuration, and security policy baselines.
professionalSummary.witness: Coordinated changes with the application team and security, recording that the application team owned application configuration and security owned the policy baseline while I owned the cluster configuration and the production window.

professionalSummary.text: Documented runbooks, known limitations, and hand-over conditions for each platform change, ensuring clear operational guidance.
professionalSummary.witness: Responsibilities included platform ownership, production change decisions and execution, infrastructure code, pipelines and the weekly change review over about three years.

experienceHighlights.text: Three-year tenure as the named owner of the credit workflow system’s runtime platform, overseeing all production changes and ensuring high availability.
